en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.669 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) Al-Farra' that
a man from among their companions said to him: "Sometimes the time of prayer becomes unclear for us on a cloudy day."
The Imam said: "Do you know these birds that you have in Iraq, which are called roosters (duyook)?"
The Imam said: "When their voices rise and they begin to respond to each other, then at that time, pray."
